tenderSchedule.title: Tender for procurement of integrated Hardware Audio-Visual and Video Conferencing system to run the VC platform in in the High Court of Karnataka .
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for procurement of integrated Hardware Audio-Visual and Video Conferencing system to run the VC platform in Hybrid mode and for live streaming of court proceedings, as well as for implementation of a paperless workflow in the High Court of Karnataka
tenderSchedule.locationName: HIGH COURT OF KARNATAKA BENGALURU RC

tenderAddress.blockNumber: In the Chamber's of Registrar Computer, High Court of Karnataka.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment (s) similar to the type specified in the ‘Schedule of Requirements’ up to at least xxxx % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after xxxxx and be in satisfactory operation for xxxxx months as on date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least xxxxx % of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least xxxxx months on the date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.

Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

Experience: The bidder shall have a minimum of 05 (five) years experience in supplying and installing Computers, IT-relatedequipment, AV/VC systems, CCTV systemswhich involve integration of audio and video, and shall have completed projects worth 30,00,00,000 (Rupees thirty Crore), in single or multiple projects, during at least one of the last 3 (three) financial years. (50% in case of bidder being an MSE unit)

Details of the Bidder: Company Information shall be furnished as per Annexure-3, with the Certificate of Incorporation/Registration. The bidder or the original equipment manufacturer of the quoted products (OEM) shall have a head office or regional office in Bengaluru.
Manufacturers Authorisation Form (MAF): MAF issued by the OEM to the bidder, as per Annexure-4.

Service Centre: To meet the technical qualification criteria, the Bidder/OEM must maintain the support infrastructure: a) A head office or regional office with established service and technical support facilities in Bengaluru, b) Service and technical support presence in at least four revenue regions of the State and c) A minimum of one service representative stationed at every district headquarters.
Direct Presence of OEM: The OEM of the quoted product must have a direct presence in India. Documentary evidence confirming the same must be submitted along with Annexure-7.

SERVICE & RMA Setup of OEM: The OEM of the quoted product must maintain i) a dedicated online product support center, ii) a toll-free number accessible during standard working hours, and iii) a fully equipped repair and maintenance facility in India. Supporting documents confirming these facilities must be submitted along with Annexure-8.

PRODUCT CERTIFICATES: All products shall carry the certifications mandatory under law, including BIS registration under the Compulsory Registration Order MeitYsEssential Requirements, and the ISO/CE/FCC/UL certifications specified in Annexures 15 to 38. BIS certificates shall be in the name of the OEMs manufacturing facility. Production of copies of relevant certificates is mandatory.
PROCESS & QUALITY CERTIFICATIONS: The OEM shall hold CMMI Level 3, ISO 9001 or higher certification. Production of copies of relevant certificates is mandatory.

PRODUCT WARRANTY: All products and accessories shall have an OEM warranty, covering the entire 5-year Warranty Period under Clause 5. A letter from the OEM confirming this shall be attached with the tender.

The Undertaking by Participant/Bidder in conformity with the following:Undertaking by participant/Bidder in pursuance of Govt. Circular on Border Country Land sharing - vide circular no: FD 455 Exp-12/2020, dated 10.03.2021, and clarifications issued by the office Memorandum No: F.18/37/2020-PPO, Dtd: 08.02.2021, or any other GO issued later as per the pro-forma attached at Annexure-14.Other Tender Terms and Conditions.
Startup Company: Bidders claiming startup relaxation under Clause 23(m) shall enclose proof of startup status.

Undertaking- under Annexure-III of G.O. No. FD-455 Exp-12, 2020, Bengaluru, dated 01.04.2023, in the formats at Annexure-14: Certificate A (all bidders) Certificate B (where the bidder proposes to sub-contract any installation works under Clause 23(q)) and Certificate C (where the bidder has a specified Transfer of Technology arrangement requiring registration). Certificates B and C are to be submitted only where applicable.
Technical Specification of the list of items for the AV/VC System mentioned above. Annexure-15 to 38

Annual Turnover: The Bidders average annual turnover of the last 3 (three) financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) must be at least.30,00,00,000 (Rupees thirty Crore). (50% in case of bidder being an MSE unit)Turnover details and supporting documents must be submitted as Annexure-1 (Financial Status). This turnover information will only be accepted if certified by a Chartered Accountant.Bidder should not have a negative net worth during all the preceding 3 yearsNote: MSE status of bidder will be considered based on Udyam Registration certificate with the Activity Manufacture / Trading / Service
